## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test --no-file-parallelism` pass.
- [ ] New behaviour has tests.
- [ ] The README's tools table matches the tools, if a tool was added, removed or renamed.
- [ ] The README and the docs say the same thing as the code.
- [ ] No secret, sandbox handle, wallet key or `.env` file is in the change.
- [ ] Text that agents or users read uses plain words and names no hosting company.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, such as `fix:` or `docs:`.
